title: Build a KYC review workspace
description: Give compliance reviewers a dedicated sidebar workspace with a pending queue, a live badge, and approve or reject actions.
problem: Compliance reviewers need a focused queue of investors awaiting identity verification, with a visible count of pending work and one-click decisions, instead of searching a full investors collection.
summary: Define a standalone workspace with defineWorkspace that groups pending, approved, and rejected views over one collection, shows a live pending badge, and restricts access to reviewer roles.
runtimeNotes: Declarative workspace, views, and mutation actions. Role names in access must match the roles your auth collection assigns.
intents: add a compliance workspace to the admin sidebar
show a pending count badge in navigation
approve or reject records with one click
